0.9.1.title: Member-list scrolling
0.9.1.description: Removed page-wide attachment-tooltip selectors that caused recurring long main-thread stalls while browsing server members. Member styling and live blur are preserved.

0.9.1.title: Attachment hover labels
0.9.1.description: Attachment hover labels now use Discord's native tooltip appearance. Attachment action buttons and reaction hover details retain their glass styling.

0.9.0.title: The Great Optimization Update
0.9.0.description: Reduced repeated glass-material calculations when Discord mounts chat rows and settings. Live blur, glass profiles, colors, and layout are preserved.

0.9.0.title: Lighter unread glow
0.9.0.description: Unread dots retain their smooth white pulse using fixed halos and opacity animation, avoiding continuous shadow repainting. Reduced motion remains supported.

0.9.0.title: Focused selectors
0.9.0.description: Replaced broad class-name searches for embeds, autocomplete, composer icons, and link icons with verified current Discord classes.

0.8.18.title: Current Discord selectors
0.8.18.description: Removed legacy class-name compatibility aliases and retained only the current Discord selectors. Glass styling, blur values, layout rules, and customization settings are unchanged.

0.8.17.title: Discord compatibility
0.8.17.description: Restored wallpaper, glass panels, chat, channels, and settings styling after Discord renamed its internal CSS classes. Updated 371 class mappings while retaining compatibility with the previous client.

0.8.16.title: Friends sidebar
0.8.16.description: Added an option to hide the persistent right-side friends sidebar and reclaim its space. Hidden by default; set --show-friends-sidebar to 1 to show it again. Server member lists remain available.

0.8.15.title: Forum post cards
0.8.15.description: Added rounded glass backgrounds and soft shadows to forum post cards while preserving their layout and the transparent post list.

0.8.14.title: Forum posts
0.8.14.description: Removed the solid black background behind forum post lists so the theme wallpaper shows through.

0.8.13.title: Unread markers
0.8.13.description: Smaller white notification dots with a brighter halo and a quicker, smoother pulse.

0.8.12.title: Unread markers
0.8.12.description: Channel unread dots now pulse gently with a soft white glow.

0.8.12.title: Reduced motion
0.8.12.description: Unread dots stay steady when reduced motion is enabled.

0.8.11.title: Sidebar separators
0.8.11.description: Consistent neutral divider lines and aligned spacing in the channel sidebar.

0.8.10.title: Unread markers
0.8.10.description: Glowing white dots stay fully visible in the channel list.

0.8.10.title: Channels
0.8.10.description: Channel icons stay aligned when unread status changes.

0.8.9.title: Mentions
0.8.9.description: Rounder glass pills with more padding and subtle reflections.

0.8.9.title: Links
0.8.9.description: Softer rounded corners and refined glass highlights.

0.8.8.title: Acrylic
0.8.8.description: Reduced grain opacity for a more transparent finish.

0.8.7.title: Acrylic
0.8.7.description: Added subtle static grain to acrylic surfaces.

0.8.6.title: Embeds
0.8.6.description: Refined embed typography and attachment hover controls.

0.8.6.title: Theme updates
0.8.6.description: Updated theme version so the installer detects these changes.

0.8.5.title: Date dividers
0.8.5.description: Date separators now share the theme's glass separator styling.

0.8.3.title: Unread separator
0.8.3.description: Unified the unread separator's glass bar appearance.

0.8.2.title: Server list
0.8.2.description: Added server rings and refined glass styling.

0.8.1.description: Fixed mouse-wheel scrolling in the horizontal server list.
